@@ -0,0 +1,186 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Execute the release bootstrap boundary with build/download commands stubbed."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import re
+import shlex
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import MappingProxyType
+from typing import ClassVar, Mapping
+
+
+SHELL = r"""set -euo pipefail
+repo=$1
+job_root=$2
+RUNNER_TEMP=$3
+evidence="$job_root/evidence"
+
+snapshot() {
+  local phase=$1 name
+  for name in GOMAXPROCS GOGC GOMEMLIMIT GOFLAGS TMPDIR GOTMPDIR GOCACHE CC CXX PATH CGO_ENABLED; do
+    if [[ -v $name ]]; then
+      printf 'state\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$phase" "$name" "${!name}"
+    fi
+  done
+}
+preflight() { printf 'guard\tpreflight\n'; }
+clean_tip() { printf 'guard\tclean_tip\n'; }
+run() {
+  printf 'run\t%s\n' "$1"
+  if [[ $1 == make ]]; then
+    snapshot make
+  fi
+}
+go() {
+  if [[ $* != 'env GOAMD64 GOARM64 GOEXPERIMENT CGO_ENABLED' ]]; then
+    printf 'unexpected direct Go invocation: %s\n' "$*" >&2
+    return 97
+  fi
+  printf 'v1\nv8.0\n\n1\n'
+}
+source "$4"
+bootstrap
+snapshot ready
+printf 'complete\n'
+"""
+
+
+class BootstrapEnvironmentTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    root: ClassVar[Path]
+    temporary: ClassVar[tempfile.TemporaryDirectory[str]]
+    sandbox: ClassVar[Path]
+    compiler_bin: ClassVar[Path]
+    states: ClassVar[Mapping[str, Mapping[str, str]]]
+    stages: ClassVar[tuple[str, ...]]
+
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls) -> None:
+        source = (cls.root / ".github/scripts/release-acceptance.sh").read_text()
+        definitions = re.findall(r"^bootstrap\(\) \{\n.*?^\}$", source, re.M | re.S)
+        if len(definitions) != 1:
+            raise ValueError("release executor must define exactly one bootstrap function")
+
+        cls.temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="logos-bootstrap-contract-")
+        cls.addClassCleanup(cls.temporary.cleanup)
+        cls.sandbox = Path(cls.temporary.name)
+        repo = cls.sandbox / "repo"
+        runner = cls.sandbox / "runner"
+        job_root = runner / "job"
+        cls.compiler_bin = cls.sandbox / "commands"
+        for directory in (repo / "src", repo / "bin", repo / "pkg/tool/linux_amd64",
+                          job_root / "evidence", cls.compiler_bin):
+            directory.mkdir(parents=True)
+
+        # The restricted PATH contains only filesystem utilities and fake compilers.
+        # run() never executes a downloader, Go command, make, or C compilation.
+        for name in ("mkdir", "ls", "ln", "sha256sum"):
+            command = shutil.which(name)
+            if command is None:
+                raise ValueError(f"test prerequisite is absent: {name}")
+            (cls.compiler_bin / name).symlink_to(command)
+        for name, version in (("gcc-14", "14.2.0"), ("g++-14", "14.2.0"),
+                              ("g++", "13.1.0")):
+            compiler = cls.compiler_bin / name
+            compiler.write_text(f"#!/bin/sh\nprintf '%s\\n' '{version}'\n")
+            compiler.chmod(0o755)
+        for name in ("bin/go", "bin/logos", "pkg/tool/linux_amd64/compile",
+                     "pkg/tool/linux_amd64/link", "pkg/tool/linux_amd64/asm",
+                     "pkg/tool/linux_amd64/cgo"):
+            (repo / name).write_text("inert tool identity fixture\n")
+
+        bootstrap = cls.sandbox / "bootstrap.sh"
+        bootstrap.write_text(f"{definitions[0]}\n")
+        process = subprocess.run(
+            ["/bin/bash", "--noprofile", "--norc", "-c", SHELL, "bootstrap-test",
+             str(repo), str(job_root), str(runner), str(bootstrap)],
+            cwd=repo,
+            env={"PATH": str(cls.compiler_bin), "LC_ALL": "C"},
+            check=True,
+            capture_output=True,
+            text=True,
+            timeout=5,
+        )
+        states: dict[str, dict[str, str]] = {"make": {}, "ready": {}}
+        stages: list[str] = []
+        for line in process.stdout.splitlines():
+            fields = line.split("\t", 3)
+            if fields[0] == "state" and len(fields) == 4:
+                states[fields[1]][fields[2]] = fields[3]
+            elif fields[0] == "run" and len(fields) == 2:
+                stages.append(fields[1])
+        if not process.stdout.endswith("complete\n"):
+            raise ValueError("bootstrap did not reach its acceptance boundary")
+        cls.states = MappingProxyType({
+            phase: MappingProxyType(values) for phase, values in states.items()
+        })
+        cls.stages = tuple(stages)
+
+    def test_make_is_bounded_and_acceptance_uses_a_new_cache(self) -> None:
+        build = self.states["make"]
+        for name, expected in (("GOMAXPROCS", "2"), ("GOGC", "50"),
+                               ("GOMEMLIMIT", "2GiB"), ("GOFLAGS", "-p=2")):
+            with self.subTest(name=name):
+                self.assertEqual(build[name], expected)
+        self.assertEqual(self.stages.count("make"), 1)
+        self.assertLess(self.stages.index("make"), self.stages.index("installed-go"))
+        self.assertIn("c23-compile", self.stages)
+        self.assertIn("c23-run", self.stages)
+        self.assertNotEqual(build["GOCACHE"], self.states["ready"]["GOCACHE"])
+        self.assertEqual(list(Path(self.states["ready"]["GOCACHE"]).iterdir()), [])
+
+    def test_acceptance_does_not_inherit_build_limits(self) -> None:
+        for name in ("GOMAXPROCS", "GOGC", "GOMEMLIMIT", "GOFLAGS"):
+            with self.subTest(name=name):
+                self.assertNotIn(
+                    name, self.states["ready"],
+                    f"make-only {name} reaches the acceptance environment",
+                )
+
+    def test_c_and_cxx_compilers_have_matching_lto_versions(self) -> None:
+        ready = self.states["ready"]
+        versions: dict[str, str] = {}
+        for name, fallback in (("CC", "cc"), ("CXX", "g++")):
+            command = shlex.split(ready.get(name, fallback))
+            executable = shutil.which(command[0], path=ready["PATH"])
+            self.assertIsNotNone(executable, f"effective {name} is absent")
+            assert executable is not None
+            self.assertTrue(Path(executable).resolve().is_relative_to(self.compiler_bin))
+            process = subprocess.run(
+                [executable, *command[1:], "-dumpfullversion", "-dumpversion"],
+                check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5,
+                env={"PATH": str(self.compiler_bin), "LC_ALL": "C"},
+            )
+            versions[name] = process.stdout.strip()
+        self.assertEqual(versions["CC"], versions["CXX"],
+                         f"C and C++ LTO versions differ: {versions}")
+
+    def test_go_test_temp_files_are_inside_the_local_temp_boundary(self) -> None:
+        ready = self.states["ready"]
+        temporary_root = Path(ready["TMPDIR"]).resolve()
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=ready["GOTMPDIR"]) as directory:
+            attack = Path(directory) / "linker-input.o"
+            attack.write_bytes(b"local linker security fixture")
+            self.assertTrue(
+                attack.resolve().is_relative_to(temporary_root),
+                f"GOTMPDIR fixture {attack} lies outside local TMPDIR {temporary_root}",
+            )
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("root", type=Path)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    BootstrapEnvironmentTests.root = args.root.resolve()
+    suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromTestCase(BootstrapEnvironmentTests)
+    result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
+    return 0 if result.wasSuccessful() else 1
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+// Copyright 2026 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.

+
+package load
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"internal/testenv"
+	"maps"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"slices"
+	"strings"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"cmd/go/internal/cfg"
+	"cmd/go/internal/modload"
+
+	"golang.org/x/mod/module"
+)
+
+func TestScanModuleKindsDuplicateSiblings(t *testing.T) {
+	const modPath = "example.com/m"
+	const duplicate = "correctness::duplicate_stem_filename"
+	const mixedPackage = "correctness::mixed_package"
+	tests := []struct {
+		name       string
+		files      map[string]string
+		plainGo    bool
+		selectedGo bool
+		importErr  string
+		scanErr    string
+		wantGo     []string
+		wantLogos  []string
+	}{
+		{
+			name: "canonical_alias",
+			files: map[string]string{
+				"sibling/x.lgo":        "package sibling\n",
+				"sibling/x.\U0001f4dc": "package sibling\n",
+			},
+			importErr: duplicate,
+			wantLogos: []string{modPath + "/good", modPath + "/sibling"},
+		},
+		{
+			name: "alias_alias",
+			files: map[string]string{
+				"sibling/x.\u26a1":     "package sibling\n",
+				"sibling/x.\U0001f4dc": "package sibling\n",
+			},
+			importErr: duplicate,
+			wantLogos: []string{modPath + "/good", modPath + "/sibling"},
+		},
+		{
+			name: "variation_alias",
+			files: map[string]string{
+				"sibling/x.\u26a1":       "package sibling\n",
+				"sibling/x.\u26a1\ufe0f": "package sibling\n",
+			},
+			importErr: duplicate,
+			wantLogos: []string{modPath + "/good", modPath + "/sibling"},
+		},
+		{
+			name: "external_test_alias",
+			files: map[string]string{
+				"sibling/x_test.lgo":        "package sibling_test\n",
+				"sibling/x_test.\U0001f4dc": "package sibling_test\n",
+			},
+			importErr: duplicate,
+			wantLogos: []string{modPath + "/good", modPath + "/sibling"},
+		},
+		{
+			name: "duplicate_kind_still_mixes_module",
+			files: map[string]string{
+				"sibling/x.lgo":        "package sibling\n",
+				"sibling/x.\U0001f4dc": "package sibling\n",
+			},
+			selectedGo: true,
+			importErr:  duplicate,
+			wantGo:     []string{modPath + "/good"},
+			wantLogos:  []string{modPath + "/sibling"},
+		},
+		{
+			name: "malformed_header_still_fails",
+			files: map[string]string{
+				"sibling/x.lgo":        "package\n",
+				"sibling/x.\U0001f4dc": "package sibling\n",
+			},
+			importErr: "expected 'IDENT'",
+			scanErr:   "expected 'IDENT'",
+		},
+		{
+			name: "mixed_package_still_fails",
+			files: map[string]string{
+				"sibling/x.lgo":        "package sibling\n",
+				"sibling/x.\U0001f4dc": "package sibling\n",
+				"sibling/z.go":         "package sibling\n",
+			},
+			importErr: mixedPackage,
+			scanErr:   mixedPackage,
+		},
+		{
+			name: "plain_go_ignores_alias_siblings",
+			files: map[string]string{
+				"sibling/x.lgo":        "package sibling\n",
+				"sibling/x.\U0001f4dc": "package sibling\n",
+			},
+			plainGo:    true,
+			selectedGo: true,
+			importErr:  "no buildable Go source files",
+			wantGo:     []string{modPath + "/good"},
+		},
+	}
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			if os.Getenv("GO_LOGOS_CENSUS_CHILD") != "1" {
+				// A fresh process fixes the working directory before cfg, fsys,
+				// module discovery, and cached build tags observe it.
+				root := t.TempDir()
+				files := maps.Clone(tt.files)
+				files["go.mod"] = "module " + modPath + "\n\ngo 1.27\n"
+				selected := "good/p.lgo"
+				if tt.selectedGo {
+					selected = "good/p.go"
+				}
+				files[selected] = "package good\n"
+				for name, source := range files {
+					path := filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(name))
+					if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o777); err != nil {
+						t.Fatal(err)
+					}
+					if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(source), 0o666); err != nil {
+						t.Fatal(err)
+					}
+				}
+				ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(t.Context(), 30*time.Second)
+				defer cancel()
+				cmd := testenv.CommandContext(t, ctx, testenv.Executable(t), "-test.run=^TestScanModuleKindsDuplicateSiblings$/^"+tt.name+"$", "-test.v")
+				cmd.Dir = root
+				cmd.Env = append(cmd.Environ(),
+					"GO_LOGOS_CENSUS_CHILD=1", "GO111MODULE=on", "GOWORK=off",
+					"GOENV=off", "GOFLAGS=", "GOPROXY=off", "GOSUMDB=off", "GOTOOLCHAIN=local")
+				if out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
+					t.Fatalf("census subprocess: %v\n%s", err, out)
+				}
+				return
+			}
+
+			cfg.Logos = !tt.plainGo
+			cfg.BuildContext.ToolTags = slices.DeleteFunc(slices.Clone(cfg.BuildContext.ToolTags), func(tag string) bool { return tag == "logos" })
+			if cfg.Logos {
+				cfg.BuildContext.ToolTags = append(cfg.BuildContext.ToolTags, "logos")
+			}
+			cfg.BuildContext.CgoEnabled = false
+			ld := modload.NewLoader()
+			modload.LoadModFile(ld, t.Context())
+			if !ld.MainModules.Contains(modPath) {
+				t.Fatal("test module was not loaded")
+			}
+
+			// Normal package selection must retain its local error. The census
+			// may ignore only a duplicate-stem error with complete file kinds.
+			if _, err := cfg.BuildContext.ImportDir("sibling", 0); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), tt.importErr) {
+				t.Fatalf("selected sibling error = %v, want %q", err, tt.importErr)
+			}
+			g := &moduleKinds{
+				goPkgs:    make(map[string]bool),
+				logosPkgs: make(map[string]bool),
+				module:    module.Version{Path: modPath},
+				carrier:   &Package{PackagePublic: PackagePublic{ImportPath: modPath + "/good"}},
+			}
+			if tt.selectedGo {
+				g.goPkgs[modPath+"/good"] = true
+			} else {
+				g.logosPkgs[modPath+"/good"] = true
+			}
+			err := scanModuleKinds(t.Context(), ld, g)

+// Each scenario starts a new test process so GOMAXPROCS is set before package
+// initialization. The tests observe only the existing execution helpers.
+func TestRunBinaryExecutionQueue(t *testing.T) {
+	if scenario := os.Getenv("GOPARITY_EXECUTION_QUEUE_CASE"); scenario != "" {
+		if got := runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0); got != 2 {
+			t.Fatalf("scenario GOMAXPROCS = %d, want 2", got)
+		}
+		dir := os.Getenv("GOPARITY_EXECUTION_QUEUE_DIR")
+		switch scenario {
+		case "shared_queue_budget":
+			testExecutionQueueBudget(t, dir)
+		case "start_error_release":
+			testExecutionQueueStartError(t, dir)
+		case "timeout_release":
+			testExecutionQueueTimeout(t, dir)
+		default:
+			t.Fatalf("unknown execution queue scenario %q", scenario)
+		}
+		return
+	}
+
+	fork := forkTool(t)
+	buildDir := t.TempDir()
+	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(buildDir, "go.mod"), []byte("module queuehelper\n\ngo 1.27\n"), 0o644); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(buildDir, "main.go"), []byte(executionQueueHelper), 0o644); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	helper := filepath.Join(buildDir, "helper")
+	if out, err := goBuild(fork.bin, buildDir, []string{"build", "-o", helper, "."}, baseEnv(forkCache(), fork.goroot), 5*time.Minute); err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("building execution queue helper: %v\n%s", err, out)
+	}
+	self, err := os.Executable()
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	for _, scenario := range []string{"shared_queue_budget", "start_error_release", "timeout_release"} {
+		t.Run(scenario, func(t *testing.T) {
+			dir := t.TempDir()
+			programs := []string{"holder0", "holder1", "control", "queued", "probe", "timeout0", "timeout1", "timeout2"}
+			for _, name := range programs {
+				cloneBinary(t, helper, filepath.Join(dir, name))
+			}
+			t.Cleanup(func() {
+				// Release surviving helpers even if the scenario process hit its
+				// watchdog before its own cleanup could run.
+				for _, name := range programs {
+					if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, name+".release"), nil, 0o600); err != nil {
+						t.Errorf("releasing %s: %v", name, err)
+					}
+				}
+			})
+			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 45*time.Second)
+			defer cancel()
+			cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, self,
+				"-test.run=^TestRunBinaryExecutionQueue$", "-test.count=1",
+				"-test.parallel=1", "-test.timeout=40s", "-test.v")
+			cmd.Env = appendEnv(os.Environ(), "GOMAXPROCS=2",
+				"GOPARITY_EXECUTION_QUEUE_CASE="+scenario,
+				"GOPARITY_EXECUTION_QUEUE_DIR="+dir)
+			cmd.WaitDelay = pipeWaitDelay
+			setNewProcessGroup(cmd)
+			cmd.Cancel = func() error {
+				killProcessGroup(cmd)
+				return nil
+			}
+			out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
+			if err != nil {
+				t.Fatalf("execution queue scenario %s: %v (watchdog: %v)\n%s", scenario, err, ctx.Err(), out)
+			}
+			t.Logf("%s", out)
+		})
+	}
+}

+type executionQueueResult struct {
+	obs observation
+	err error
+}
+
+func testExecutionQueueBudget(t *testing.T, dir string) {
+	var wg sync.WaitGroup
+	t.Cleanup(func() {
+		for _, name := range []string{"holder0", "holder1"} {
+			if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, name+".release"), nil, 0o600); err != nil {
+				t.Errorf("releasing %s: %v", name, err)
+			}
+		}
+		wg.Wait()
+	})
+	startRow := func(name string) <-chan executionQueueResult {
+		done := make(chan executionQueueResult, 1)
+		wg.Go(func() {
+			rows, err := runAll(buildResult{outDir: dir, progs: []string{name}}, "4", nil)
+			obs, ok := rows[name]
+			if err == nil && (!ok || len(rows) != 1) {
+				err = fmt.Errorf("row %s returned %d observations, named observation present: %t", name, len(rows), ok)
+			}
+			done <- executionQueueResult{obs, err}
+		})
+		return done
+	}
+
+	row0 := startRow("holder0")
+	executionQueueReady(t, filepath.Join(dir, "holder0"), row0)
+	obs, err := runBinaryTimeout(filepath.Join(dir, "control"), "4", 2*time.Second, corpusNorm)
+	executionQueueOK(t, "control with one holder", executionQueueResult{obs, err})
+	t.Log("capacity N-1: one holder leaves one runnable slot")
+
+	row1 := startRow("holder1")
+	executionQueueReady(t, filepath.Join(dir, "holder1"), row1)
+	t.Log("capacity N: two independent runAll rows are ready")
+	queued := make(chan executionQueueResult, 1)
+	submitted := make(chan struct{})
+	wg.Go(func() {
+		close(submitted)
+		obs, err := runBinaryTimeout(filepath.Join(dir, "queued"), "4", 2*time.Second, corpusNorm)
+		queued <- executionQueueResult{obs, err}
+	})
+	<-submitted
+	hold := time.NewTimer(3 * time.Second)
+	defer hold.Stop()
+	select {
+	case got := <-queued:
+		t.Fatalf("third call returned while two independent rows still held their slots: observation=%+v error=%v", got.obs, got.err)
+	case got := <-row0:
+		t.Fatalf("first holder returned before release: observation=%+v error=%v", got.obs, got.err)
+	case got := <-row1:
+		t.Fatalf("second holder returned before release: observation=%+v error=%v", got.obs, got.err)
+	case <-hold.C:
+	}
+	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(dir, "queued.ready")); !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
+		t.Fatalf("third child started before a slot was released: marker stat = %v", err)
+	}
+	t.Log("capacity N+1: third call remained queued longer than its two-second child budget")
+	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "holder0.release"), nil, 0o600); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	executionQueueOK(t, "first released row", executionQueueReceive(t, row0))
+	executionQueueOK(t, "queued call after release", executionQueueReceive(t, queued))
+	executionQueueReady(t, filepath.Join(dir, "queued"), nil)
+	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "holder1.release"), nil, 0o600); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	executionQueueOK(t, "second released row", executionQueueReceive(t, row1))
+	obs, err = runBinaryTimeout(filepath.Join(dir, "probe"), "4", 2*time.Second, corpusNorm)
+	executionQueueOK(t, "call after successful rows", executionQueueResult{obs, err})
+}
+
+func testExecutionQueueStartError(t *testing.T, dir string) {
+	for i := range 3 {
+		_, err := runBinaryTimeout(filepath.Join(dir, fmt.Sprintf("missing%d", i)), "4", 2*time.Second, corpusNorm)
+		if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
+			t.Fatalf("missing executable %d: got %v, want file-not-found error", i, err)
+		}
+		t.Logf("start failure %d returned its file-not-found error", i)
+	}
+	obs, err := runBinaryTimeout(filepath.Join(dir, "probe"), "4", 2*time.Second, corpusNorm)
+	executionQueueOK(t, "call after N+1 start failures", executionQueueResult{obs, err})
+}
+
+func testExecutionQueueTimeout(t *testing.T, dir string) {
+	var wg sync.WaitGroup
+	t.Cleanup(func() {
+		for i := range 3 {
+			if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, fmt.Sprintf("timeout%d.release", i)), nil, 0o600); err != nil {
+				t.Errorf("releasing timeout child %d: %v", i, err)
+			}
+		}
+		wg.Wait()
+	})
+	for i := range 3 {
+		path := filepath.Join(dir, fmt.Sprintf("timeout%d", i))
+		done := make(chan executionQueueResult, 1)
+		wg.Go(func() {
+			obs, err := runBinaryTimeout(path, "4", 2*time.Second, corpusNorm)
+			done <- executionQueueResult{obs, err}
+		})
+		pid := executionQueueReady(t, path, done)
+		got := executionQueueReceive(t, done)
+		if got.err == nil || !strings.Contains(got.err.Error(), "goparity run timeout") {
+			t.Fatalf("ready child %d: got %v, want goparity run timeout", i, got.err)
+		}
+		if got.obs.stdout != "" || got.obs.stderr != "" {
+			t.Fatalf("timed-out child %d produced unexpected output: %+v", i, got.obs)
+		}
+		if processGroupKillSupported() && !procGroupGone(pid, 4*time.Second) {
+			t.Fatalf("timed-out child %d process group %d survived", i, pid)
+		}
+		t.Logf("timeout %d returned after child readiness", i)
+	}
+	obs, err := runBinaryTimeout(filepath.Join(dir, "probe"), "4", 2*time.Second, corpusNorm)
+	executionQueueOK(t, "call after N+1 real child timeouts", executionQueueResult{obs, err})
+}
+
+func executionQueueReady(t *testing.T, path string, done <-chan executionQueueResult) int {
+	t.Helper()
+	timer := time.NewTimer(5 * time.Second)
+	defer timer.Stop()
+	tick := time.NewTicker(10 * time.Millisecond)
+	defer tick.Stop()
+	for {
+		data, err := os.ReadFile(path + ".ready")
+		if err == nil {
+			pid, err := strconv.Atoi(string(data))
+			if err != nil || pid <= 0 {
+				t.Fatalf("invalid readiness marker for %s: %q (%v)", path, data, err)
+			}
+			return pid
+		}
+		if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		select {
+		case got := <-done:
+			t.Fatalf("%s returned before readiness: observation=%+v error=%v", path, got.obs, got.err)
+		case <-timer.C:
+			t.Fatalf("%s did not write its readiness marker", path)
+		case <-tick.C:
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+func executionQueueReceive(t *testing.T, done <-chan executionQueueResult) executionQueueResult {
+	t.Helper()
+	select {
+	case got := <-done:
+		return got
+	case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
+		t.Fatal("execution call did not return after its release or child deadline")
+		return executionQueueResult{}
+	}
+}
+
+func executionQueueOK(t *testing.T, label string, got executionQueueResult) {
+	t.Helper()
+	if got.err != nil || got.obs.exit != 0 || got.obs.stdout != "ok\n" || got.obs.stderr != "" {
+		t.Fatalf("%s: observation=%+v error=%v, want exit 0, ok newline, and empty stderr", label, got.obs, got.err)
+	}
+}
+
+const executionQueueHelper = `package main
+
+import (
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"io/fs"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+)
+
+func fail(err error) {
+	fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
+	os.Exit(1)
+}
+
+func main() {
+	if got := os.Getenv("GOMAXPROCS"); got != "4" {
+		fail(fmt.Errorf("child GOMAXPROCS = %q, want 4", got))
+	}
+	path := os.Args[0]
+	ready := path + ".ready"
+	if err := os.WriteFile(ready+".tmp", []byte(strconv.Itoa(os.Getpid())), 0o600); err != nil {
+		fail(err)
+	}
+	if err := os.Rename(ready+".tmp", ready); err != nil {
+		fail(err)
+	}
+	name := filepath.Base(path)
+	if strings.HasPrefix(name, "holder") || strings.HasPrefix(name, "timeout") {
+		deadline := time.Now().Add(30 * time.Second)
+		for {
+			_, err := os.Stat(path + ".release")
+			if err == nil {
+				break
+			}
+			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
+				fail(err)
+			}
+			if time.Now().After(deadline) {
+				fail(fmt.Errorf("%s was never released", name))
+			}
+			time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond)
+		}
+	}
+	fmt.Print("ok\n")
+}
+`
